research.research_gating.alumentum.name: Alumentum
research.research_gating.alumentum.text: Coal keeps only a faint memory of the sun; alumentum hoards all of it. This restless alchemical salt locks fire inside its crystals and gives it up slowly, keeping an Arcane Furnace roaring long after coal would be ash. Alchemists prize it as captive flame for their bolder works.
research.research_gating.animated_piston: Feed this piston vis and it stirs as if dreaming, pushing and pulling with no lever or redstone to command it. Thaumaturges set it beating at the heart of their greater engines, among them the Arcane Bore, the Thaumic Restorer and the Thaumic Duplicator.
These bellows breathe on their own, exhaling an endless arcane wind. Facing a crucible or Arcane Furnace, they fan its work to a quicker pace; facing a vis tank or pump, they make it draw harder. A redstone signal stills their breath.
research.research_gating.arcane_bore.tex: Point this hungry engine at the earth and it gnaws a tunnel in the direction it faces, spitting the spoils out of its back. An arcane focus gives its appetite purpose, and an Arcane Singularity caged within supplies the raw force that drives it on.
Vis runs through this furnace like a second fire, smelting faster than any common hearth. Starve it of vis and it falters; set Arcane Bellows beside it, facing in, and its flames burn fiercer still.
research.research_gating.arcane_seal.tex: A blank seal is an unfinished sentence written in the language of the world. Placed on any surface, it waits in silence until runic essences are laid upon it, and every rune added changes its meaning and its effect.
research.research_gating.arcane_singular: Bind the hoarded fire of alumentum to the captive light of nitor and the two collapse into a tiny, furious knot of arcane force. Thrown, it skitters about for a few heartbeats before tearing itself apart in a violent blast. Caged with care, it is the beating heart of the Arcane Bore and of stranger devices yet.
research.research_gating.arcane_tinkerin: Delicate mechanisms need a gentle, knowing hand. This enchanted tool coaxes most devices to turn and face a new way, tips the dregs out of a crucible, and traces the reach of an Arcane Seal in the air.
research.research_gating.boots_of_stridi: Stitched with a charm of tireless travel, these boots quicken every step and let their wearer stride up a whole block as easily as walking a level road.
research.research_gating.enchanted_fabri: Steep wool and string in vis and the threads remember something of the aura itself: they grow light and tough, and eager to hold a charm. From this cloth thaumaturges stitch wonders such as the Portable Hole and the Inert Carpet.
research.research_gating.enchanted_silve: Silverwood grows already humming with a pure and gentle magic. Steeped further in vis, it becomes a wood that drinks in corruption, fit for devices that must cleanse and purify, the Vis Purifier chief among them.
research.research_gating.extract_of_cool: Shimmerleaf steeped with an aqueous crystal draws out the cold, patient heart of Water, which lies trembling in the vial like a held breath. Elemental tools are tempered in it.
research.research_gating.extract_of_deep: Shimmerleaf steeped with an earthen crystal draws out the slow, unyielding heart of Earth, a distillate heavier than its vial ought to allow. Elemental tools are tempered in it.
research.research_gating.extract_of_foul: Shimmerleaf steeped with a tainted crystal draws out something that should have stayed buried: a vile, writhing distillate that stains the glass. Handle it with care. Charms that snare the essence of the dead are bound with it.
research.research_gating.extract_of_ligh: Shimmerleaf steeped with a vaporous crystal draws out the restless heart of Air, which strains against the stopper as if longing to fly. It lends lift to the Inert Carpet and edge to elemental tools.
research.research_gating.extract_of_pure: Shimmerleaf steeped with a vis crystal draws out magic in its purest form, so concentrated that the vial hums softly in the hand. Many enchanting devices and eldritch mechanisms need its touch to awaken.
research.research_gating.extract_of_warm: Shimmerleaf steeped with a fiery crystal draws out the fierce heart of Fire, warm to the touch even through the glass. Elemental tools are forged with it, and it kindles the Brazier of Souls.
research.research_gating.nitor.name: Nitor
research.research_gating.nitor.text: A mote of living light, coaxed out of the aura and stoppered in glass. Set down, it burns on without any fuel and holds the dark at bay. Its unwavering glow is the spark that awakens runic essences and many other arcane components.
research.research_gating.portable_hole.t: This bundle of enchanted cloth carries a pocket of the Void folded into its weave. Press it to a wall or floor and it unfolds, swallowing the blocks before you into a temporary passage. When the hole closes the world quietly returns to its place, but every use frays the cloth a little more.
research.research_gating.runic_essence_a: The rune of Air, caught in an essence that swirls and never quite settles. Set upon an Arcane Seal, it speaks one word of the seal's incantation; join it with other runes and the seal says something new.
research.research_gating.runic_essence_d: The rune of Darkness, wrung from tainted crystal into an essence that seems to swallow the light. Set upon an Arcane Seal, it speaks one word of the seal's incantation, and what it says is rarely kind.
research.research_gating.runic_essence_e: The rune of Earth, bound into a heavy, patient essence. Set upon an Arcane Seal, it speaks one word of the seal's incantation; join it with other runes and the seal says something new.
research.research_gating.runic_essence_f: The rune of Fire, sealed in an essence that flickers with its own warmth. Set upon an Arcane Seal, it speaks one word of the seal's incantation; join it with other runes and the seal says something new.
research.research_gating.runic_essence_m: The rune of Magic, suspended in an essence that glimmers with raw vis. Set upon an Arcane Seal, it speaks one word of the seal's incantation; join it with other runes and the seal says something new.
research.research_gating.runic_essence_w: The rune of Water, held in an essence that ripples at the slightest touch. Set upon an Arcane Seal, it speaks one word of the seal's incantation; join it with other runes and the seal says something new.
research.research_gating.thaumometer.tex: Through this lens the unseen currents of the world become plain. Raise it to the air to read the vis and taint of the local aura, or turn it on a thaumic device to learn how much of each it holds.
research.research_gating.vis_filter.name: Vis Filter
research.research_gating.vis_filter.text: Like a sieve of silver threads, this conduit combs the taint out of the vis flowing through it and slowly breathes it back into the aura. Filters stacked one atop another hold more taint before they must let it go.
research.research_gating.vis_pump.name: Vis Pump
research.research_gating.vis_pump.text: This pulsing device siphons vis and taint out of the container it faces and drives them along the conduits connected to it. Arcane Bellows facing it quicken its pull, and a redstone signal stills it.
research.research_gating.wand_of_equal_t: Alchemy teaches that nothing is gained without something given. Shift-right-click a block to name your price; touch the wand to another block and it, with every connected block of its kind, is exchanged for your chosen block, drawn from your own inventory.
research.research_gating.wand_of_fire.te: While held to its work, this wand roars out a jet of scorching flame that sears any creature in its path. Each use burns away a little of its strength.
research.research_gating.wand_of_lightni: This wand holds a storm in miniature. At your will it hurls a bolt of lightning from its tip to strike the creature you point at. Each bolt spends a little of its strength.
research.research_gating.wand_of_water.t: While held to its work, this wand pours out a drenching stream that leaves any creature it strikes slow and sodden. Blazes and endermen find its touch especially painful. Each use wears it a little.
